dedupe_keys.name: ratel nettest open data crowdsourced fixed mobile and wifi internet speed and quality measurements serbia

description: RATEL NetTest is the Serbian regulator's crowdsourced measurement platform for the quality of internet connections in fixed, mobile and wifi networks. Computer users test through the web at nettest.ratel.rs, and mobile users through free Android and iOS apps, which also measure packet loss, jitter, traceroute, VoIP quality, content integrity, access speed to a reference web page, connection transparency and DNS availability, alongside download and upload speed and ping. The measured results are published as open data, and the dataset is listed on the national open data portal data.gov.rs with CSV, JSON and XML resources pointing to the platform's open data page. The portal gives a start date of December 2018 and was last updated in September 2026. Coverage: Serbia. Format and access: CSV, JSON and XML downloads, free under the Open Data Licence of the Republic of Serbia, which requires attribution. Caveats: tests are self-selected and depend on user devices and wifi; the platform's open data page is script-rendered, so file structure, location precision and archive size were not checked. Simulation uses: measured speed, latency and reliability by operator and area for Serbian service models, and a check on declared coverage. Related records: the RTR NetTest open data for Austria, the AKOS Test Net open data for Slovenia and the CTU NetTest open data for Czechia come from similar open-source systems.
